翌日，清晨，勃勃生机。
五点半，刘济民就醒了，比往常早醒一个小时，他是被谢铁骊挤下床的。
单人床，睡了两个人，不挤才怪。
七点半，谢铁骊被桌边的菜香味给勾醒。
“几点了？济民。”谢铁骊翻身坐到床边，用力揉了揉脸，迷迷糊糊地问道。
“七点多一点！”
谢铁骊从桌子上拿过自己的钢表，眯着眼睛看了一眼：“可七点半了啊，这一觉是睡美了。济民啊，没挤着你吧？”
刘济民笑道：“您猜我叫什么？”
“济民.....”谢铁骊恍然大悟，拍了拍脑袋笑出了声，又带着歉意说道：“哎呦，不好意思，实在是太累了！”
“哈哈哈，我开个玩笑，这是饭菜，您先对付两口。”
谢铁骊洗了把脸，整个人精神了起来，一边吃饭，一边讲《大河奔流》的拍摄。
“老李看到《解放军文艺》上又出现你的文章了，高兴地拉着我看，说你们豫省文艺界后继有人了。李凖同志，年纪不小了，整个人就是个老顽童。”谢铁骊就喜欢跟这样的人打交道，有能力还有趣。
谢铁骊吃过饭，先回家换了一身衣服，接着就开始召集于蓝、马德波、赵绍义几人开始对剧本进行终审。
“济民同志，胖了啊！”于蓝笑着打量了一眼刘济民，调侃道。
“咱们燕影厂伙食实在是太好了！”
“吃好住好创作好，三好是分不开的。你也辛苦了，创作是很累的一件事情嘛。”
谢铁骊笑着说道：“于大姐对济民同志很是关心啊！”
“我们要关心和爱护年轻人嘛，毕竟他们是我们的下一代，是文艺工作的下一代。”于蓝笑着坐了下来，摆手示意大家也都坐。
刘济民将剧本先递给了于蓝，于蓝转头问谢铁骊觉得如何。

The next morning, it was full of life.
Liu Jimin woke up at half past five, an hour earlier than usual. He was squeezed out of bed by Xie Tieli.
The single bed sleeps two people, so it would be weird if it wasn't crowded.
At half past seven, Xie Tieli was awakened by the smell of food at the table.
"What time is it? Jimin." Xie Tieli turned over and sat on the edge of the bed, rubbed his face vigorously, and asked drowsily.
"A little after seven!"
Xie Tieli took his steel watch from the table and glanced at it with squinted eyes: "But it's half past seven. I had a good sleep this time. Jimin, I'm not squeezing you, am I?"
Liu Jimin smiled and said, "What do you think my name is?"
"Jimin..." Xie Tieli suddenly understood, patted his head and laughed out loud, then said apologetically: "Oh, I'm sorry, I'm really tired!"
"Hahaha, I'm just kidding, this is food, you have to deal with two bites first."
Xie Tieli washed his face and became energetic. While eating, he talked about the filming of "The River Runs".
"Lao Li saw that your article appeared again in "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art". He happily pulled me to read it and said that you have a successor in the literary and art circles of Henan Province. Comrade Li Yan is not young, and he is just an old naughty boy." Xie Tieli likes to deal with such people, who are capable and interesting.
After Xie Tieli had eaten, he went home and changed his clothes. Then he called Yu Lan, Ma Debo, and Zhao Shaoyi to start the final review of the script.
"Comrade Jimin, you have gained weight!" Yu Lan looked at Liu Jimin with a smile and teased.
"The food at Yanying Factory is really good!"
"Good food, good housing, good creation, and good creation are inseparable. You have worked hard too. Creating is a very tiring thing."
Xie Tieli said with a smile: "Sister Yu is very concerned about Comrade Jimin!"
"We should care for and care for young people. After all, they are our next generation and the next generation of literary and artistic work." Yu Lan sat down with a smile and waved his hand for everyone to sit down too.
Liu Jimin handed the script to Yu Lan first, and Yu Lan turned around and asked Xie Tieli what he thought.
